Name: Shie-esque Albedo Portrait
Author: SofieIsGrey
Description: This is my first time making a portrait set, and I'm not an artist by any means, so I debated over uploading this. But, in the end, if I wanted a silly lil cartoonish portrait for Albedo, someone else might too, so I'm uploading it even though I think it's kinda bad. Portrait style is meant to match [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4264]Shie's Portraits[/url]﻿.

Downloads.Description: THIS MOD REQUIRES PORTRAITURE! YOU MUST PUT THE ALBEDO.PNG IN YOUR PORTRAITURE FOLDER OR IT WILL NOT WORK!
